label: copy-phase input "1" / delimiter when first token is 1,p,r,k,j
predicate: ((phase == 2) & (in_tok == tok("1")) & (to_go >= 1)) | ((phase == 1) & isin(out_tok, [tok("1"), tok("p"), tok("r"), tok("k"), tok("j")]))
explanation: Never fires during the original phase. Fires only on the <DEL> step (45% of mass) and on copy-phase steps (55%). In the copy phase it is almost only active when the fed-back input is the digit 1 (about 50% of all mass), but just ~32% of such steps fire; firing is stronger and more frequent early in the copy (recall_idx 0-2) and in short sequences, and weak on the last output step. On <DEL> it fires in 6% of sequences, much more often for short L (L=3: 5.7x lift) and when the first original token (the one about to be output) is 1, p, r, k or j. Top activations: sequences that start with 1, at the <DEL> step and at the copy step where the leading 1 is re-input. Dev precision ~0.30, recall ~0.75, mass recall ~0.82; the gating of which 1-inputs and delimiters fire is not fully captured.
